context_excerpt: 2023-12-15 **Event**: Leader B on December 15, 2023, formally signed a bill requiring Platform X's Country B parent Company Y to sell the video application within roughly nine months, or else face a ban in Country A. Under the new law, Company Y has 270 days to complete the sale, and the president may extend the deadline to one year; if the sale succeeds, Platform X can continue operating in Country A, and if it fail…
